name: Charging Robotics Inc.
summary: Charging Robotics Inc. focuses on developing a wireless electric vehicle charging technology for automatic parking lots based on its wireless electricity transfer module in Israel. The company’s technology can be used for various products, such as robotic and stationary platforms. Charging Robotics Inc. is headquartered in Tel Aviv-Yafo, Israel. Charging Robotics Inc. is a subsidiary of Medigus Ltd.
